result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.network_proximity()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute network proximity between two sets of nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L15953-L16017){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.network_proximity( set_a, set_b, method="closest", ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Measures how close two groups of nodes are in the network using shortest-path distances. Useful for drug-target vs. disease-gene proximity analysis and network-based drug repurposing. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [set_a]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : First set of node IDs. [set_b]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Second set of node IDs. [method]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["closest"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Proximity measure to use: - `"closest"`: minimum shortest-path distance across all (a, b) pairs. - `"shortest"`: average shortest-path distance across all reachable pairs. - `"kernel"`: average of `exp(-d)` (diffusion kernel similarity). - `"separation"`: network separation `d_AB - (d_AA + d_BB) / 2` (Menche et al., *Science* 2015). Negative values indicate overlapping neighborhoods. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : For `"closest"`, `"shortest"`, `"kernel"`: a dictionary with keys `proximity`, `reachable_pairs`, `total_pairs`. For `"separation"`: a dictionary with keys `separation`, `d_ab`, `d_aa`, `d_bb`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#05db650f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_node(label="E") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") .add_edge(source="D", target="E") ) a_id = g.get_id_from_label("A") b_id = g.get_id_from_label("B") d_id = g.get_id_from_label("D") e_id = g.get_id_from_label("E") g.network_proximity([a_id, b_id], [d_id, e_id], method="closest") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'reachable_pairs': 4.0, 'total_pairs': 4.0, 'proximity': 2.0} ``` ::: :::
